observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D3300' printed on the front, paired with a zoom lens mounted on it.
Both sit atop a retail box printed 'Nikon D3300 18-55 VR II Kit, AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm f/3.5-5.6G VR II, BLACK'.
Lens barrel shows focal markings 24-35-45-55 and a 'VR' logo, consistent with the 18-55mm VR II kit lens named on the box.
Background shows unrelated flash units (Godox TT520, Yongnuo) and other boxed electronics, suggesting a shop/stall display, not the buyer's own storage.
No photo shows the camera powered on, LCD screen, shutter count, memory card slot, battery, or any test/sample image.
No photo shows the lens glass (front or rear element) close up, mount contacts, or signs of fungus/scratches.
A watermark 'PHOTOPLUG INTEGRATED' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' appears across both images, indicating a repost from a listing site, not necessarily the current seller's own photo.
